rationale: Use DOMPurify wherever a browser DOM is available, because parsing with the real DOM is the strongest defence against mutation XSS. Use sanitize-html for Node and SSR, where jsdom would add 27 MB for the same outcome. Use rehype-sanitize when content already flows through remark/rehype, which is the case for the assistant-ui react-markdown pipeline. Keep isomorphic-dompurify on hold: it is correct, but only worth its jsdom footprint if you need DOMPurify specifically on the server. Keep xss on hold: it is fast and safe in the harness, but its escape-not-strip model and lack of independent advisory coverage make it a weaker default. insane and sanitizer are abandoned and must not be used. No package in this category publishes npm provenance, so pin exact versions, subscribe to advisories for the chosen sanitizer, and re-review every 90 days. A 25-vector headless-Chrome corpus executed 11 vectors unsanitized and zero after every tested sanitizer.
